instruction: Retrieve LibreOffice performance metrics for Calc, Impress, and Writer related to GPT-4 from '~/Documents/awesome-desktop/expe-results.xlsx', and insert them as a table in the 'Main Results' section.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting LibreOffice application-specific performance metrics (Calc, Impress, Writer) for GPT-4 from Excel and creating a table in the Main Results section. The evaluator verifies all requirements: table location in correct section, GPT-4 specificity, all three office apps present as distinct words, and numeric performance metrics. All-or-nothing scoring ensures complete task execution.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 = all requirements met (Main Results section + GPT-4 reference + all 3 office apps + numeric metrics), 0.0 = any requirement missing
